custom_design_text: Share a photo or reference image of the design you have in mind, along with your requirements — metal type, weight, and budget. We'll help you make it in real.

about_paragraph_1: Shagun Jewellery is a Dubai-based retailer bringing you a curated selection of gold and silver jewellery, sourced from trusted suppliers
about_paragraph_2: Have Gold jewellery you no longer wear? We buy old and used gold and silver at fair, transparent rates based on the day's purity and weight. Bring it in for a free evaluation

footer_note: A new Dubai business built on trust, honest service, and fair pricing. Prices follow daily gold & silver rates. Exchanges/returns follow UAE guidelines — ask our team for details.
